SELECT 'sales' t, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dk, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ds, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0, NULL, NULL FROM fact_web_order

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key, quantity, net_amount, sale_ts_utc)) v, MIN(sale_date) mn, MAX(sale_date) mx FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT c, v, date_trunc('month', mn) m, COUNT(*) n FROM d GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
yearly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),1) AS growth_pct
FROM yearly ty JOIN yearly ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) v FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2),
rpt AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) v FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,r.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,r.store_id) st, m.v mine, r.v rpt, ROUND(COALESCE(m.v,0)-COALESCE(r.v,0),2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN rpt r ON m.fiscal_year=r.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=r.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.v,0)-COALESCE(r.v,0))>0.5 ORDER BY 1,2
